lookahead_bias.signal_information_cutoff: The 30 daily log returns ending at signal_date_utc close.
lookahead_bias.execution_assumption: Next consecutive UTC daily candle open; signal feature is not recomputed with that candle.
lookahead_bias.limitations: No option quote or strategy PnL exists in this study; marks are hypothetical model values.

survivorship_bias.limitations: A present-day BTCUSDT history is not a delisted-inclusive, point-in-time Binance asset universe. Do not use it to claim cross-sectional strategy performance.
survivorship_bias.required_for_universe_backtest: Point-in-time symbol membership including delisted/renamed pairs, listing and delisting dates, and inclusion rules fixed as of each historical date.
